command.name: security key-manager keystore delete
command.description: This command is used to delete keystore configurations. Only keystore configurations that are not enabled can be deleted. Use the security key-manager keystore show -enable false command to see a list of all the keystore configurations that are not enabled.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command deletes only the keystore configurations with the given Vserver.

parameter.name: keystore-type
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command deletes only the keystore configurations with the given keystore type. This command only deletes keystore configurations with a keystore type of Azure Key Vault (AKV) or Barbican.

parameter.name: config-name
parameter.description: If you specify this parameter, then the command deletes only the keystore configurations with the given configuration name.

example.p: The following example deletes all keystore configurations with the name "NewConfig" that are not enabled.
example.screen:
Cluster-1::*> security key-manager keystore delete -vserver * -keystore-type * -config-name NewConfig 1 entry was deleted.
Cluster-1::*>
example.p: The following example deletes the keystore configuration on Vserver vs0 with a keystore type AKV and "NewConfig" configuration name.
example.screen:
Cluster-1::*> security key-manager keystore delete -vserver vs0 -keystore-type AKV -config-name NewConfig 1 entry was deleted.
Cluster-1::*>
example.p: The following example attempts and fails to delete an enabled keystore configuration.
example.screen:
Cluster-1::*> security key-manager keystore delete -vserver vs0 -keystore-type AKV -config-name default
Error: command failed: The keystore configuration with name "default" and keystore type "AKV" is currently enabled for Vserver "vs0" and cannot be deleted.
Cluster-1::*>
